**0.9.1: the floating mic no longer makes the text jump or removes line breaks.**

- The floating mic now pastes the transcript at your cursor instead of rewriting the whole text field. The field no longer jumps around while text goes in, and a line break or blank line before the cursor stays where it is.
- The transcript is left on the clipboard after a take.
- Not yet tested on a device. arm64-v8a only. Android 9+. Downloads: [hebrish.app/download](https://hebrish.app/download).
